result.summary: The page looks largely intact. Layout, spacing, images, badges, and the bottom navigation render cleanly. The only items I found are minor contrast concerns with light gray secondary text. The clipped chip row, clipped carousel card, and cut-off card at the bottom were excluded as intended scroll and viewport behavior.

issues.description: Secondary text such as the delivery fees (e.g., '€0.90 delivery'), the meta line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' ('25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen'), and the review count '(500+)' is light gray on white, which may fall below recommended WCAG contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the white background.

issues.description: The inactive bottom navigation labels and icons ('Search', 'Orders', 'Profile') are a light gray that is hard to distinguish from the background.
issues.suggestion: Use a slightly darker gray for inactive tab items so they remain visible while keeping the active green state clearly distinguishable.
